areas.name: Indigenous and quilombola peoples
areas.reason: Relevant general and specific objective and participatory ethnodevelopment plan, but the associated indicator is not relevant and only a small share of resources reaches traditional communities.

areas.name: Environment
areas.reason: General and specific objectives, indicators, targets and relevant resources support sustainable use and restoration in rural areas, with subsidies for sustainable production.

areas.name: Disaster resilience and climate adaptation
areas.reason: Community networks for fire prevention, rural safety and climate-risk management link to existing civil-protection bodies, but only a small share of resources is focused here.

areas.name: Family farming
areas.reason: Strong focus on rural producers across all components, with indicators, targets and significant resources for sustainable and resilient production.

areas.name: Competitiveness
areas.reason: Component aims to raise economic sustainability and competitiveness of family farming organizations and traditional communities in their value chains; resources and indicator are limited.

areas.name: Water security
areas.reason: On-farm water storage and rural sanitation actions with indicators and targets, but the share of resources is not significant.

bonus.reason: Proponent did not state the project is exclusively aimed at federal PPA priorities.
Proponent did not state the project promotes regional integration.
